data.one_liner: Add message reactions and context menus with adaptive Cupertino and Material styling.
data.what_it_does: Adds chat message reactions and context menus with adaptive iOS and Material styling. It supports multiple presentations such as focused overlays, compact bars, and bottom sheets, alongside optional controller-managed state with optimistic updates.
use_when: You are building a chat application and need reaction pickers or context menus.
You want platform-adaptive styling (Cupertino on iOS/macOS, Material elsewhere).
avoid_when: Your app does not involve messaging or chat features.
You need a built-in emoji picker included directly in the package (this package has zero dependencies and requires an external picker).
strengths: Multiple swappable presenters (focused overlay, compact bar, bottom sheet, custom)
Adaptive iOS and Material styling with deep theming support
Accessible out of the box with semantics, keyboard navigation, and screen reader actions
weaknesses: Does not include a built-in emoji picker (requires a pluggable adapter)
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.32 or newer. Zero native dependencies.
